C0249.title: Zhang and Sun Operate Aggregation Apps Using Pirate Links to Disseminate Audiovisual Works
keywords: right to network dissemination of information
C0249.summary: A 2025 typical intellectual-property case from the Supreme People's Procuratorate and a Xinwu Court case note reported that, from July 2017 to January 2023, Zhang, Sun, and others operated aggregation apps including "Yingshi Daquan Pure Edition" and "Today Video." Without authorization, they uploaded works to rented cloud servers and used hotlinking to obtain playback links from major video platforms, providing more than 80,000 audiovisual works to the public and earning over RMB 392 million in advertising promotion fees. Xinwu Court convicted Zhang and Sun of copyright infringement, sentenced them to prison terms ranging from three years to five years and six months, imposed fines totaling RMB 24 million, and ordered seized and frozen criminal proceeds and property confiscated.
